tokenLayer.rule: Tokens carry appearance values only. A token may never encode a business rule, threshold, or feature condition.

themeLayer.rule: A theme is a named set of token values. Swapping a theme changes appearance only; it never changes what a component does or which data it shows.

structuralLayer.rule: Component structure, behavior, and data binding are independent of the active theme and are never generated from theme content.

layerSeparationRule: No magic numbers in the render layer: colors, bands, thresholds, and formats arrive via spec or token, never hardcoded (chart ground rule 11).
baselineRule: Every shared control and screen has an approved visual baseline. A rendered difference from baseline is a defect unless the baseline itself is changed through a governed workflow.

accessibilityRequirements.requirement: Color is never the sole encoding channel
accessibilityRequirements.rule: Severity, status, or category needs a second channel: shape, position, icon, or label, for colorblind and grayscale/offline use (chart ground rule 12)
Every interactive control reachable and operable without a pointer device
Text and meaningful graphical elements meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast ratios against their background token

visualRegressionRule: Visual regression evidence is DETERMINISTIC: same input yields identical pixels, stable sort and category order, no random jitter (chart ground rule 10).
